## About
Beltway Used Auto Parts is an environmentally conscious recycler on Kenilworth Avenue in Hyattsville. We sell quality used parts for late model cars and trucks, foreign and domestic.
Our inventory is updated daily through our yard management system, so call or e-mail and we'll tell you what's on the lot. We ship, we deliver with our own trucks, and if you have a vehicle to sell, we'll give you a bid. Se habla espanol.

## Services
- Late model auto and truck parts: Quality used parts, foreign and domestic, for cars and trucks.
- UPS, FedEx and Freight Co.: We send parts out UPS, FedEx and Freight Co. Call or e-mail for delivery information.
- Local delivery: Our own fleet of trucks delivers in Maryland, Delaware, Virginia, the District of Columbia and Pennsylvania.
- Contact us for a bid: Have a vehicle to sell? Contact us and we'll give you a bid.

## FAQ
Q: Do you deliver?
A: Yes. We ship UPS, FedEx and Freight Co, and our own trucks serve Maryland, Delaware, Virginia, the District of Columbia and Pennsylvania. Call or e-mail for delivery information.

Q: Do your parts come with a warranty?
A: Yes. We carry a 4 month standard warranty, and extended warranties are available.

Q: I have a vehicle to sell. Can you help?
A: Contact us and we'll give you a bid.
